findings.desc: Antigravity is advertised as a first-class dispatch host with wrapped-preapply guard support via dispatch, but guard-session runtime still treats antigravity/agy as watcher-only. packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:268 and packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:277 state Antigravity gets wrapped-preapply through dispatch, and packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:2016 says viaDispatch applies to Codex/Antigravity. The actual resolver only includes codex and gemini in GUARD_WRAPPED_PREAPPLY_PROVIDERS at packages/main/src/core/guard-session.ts:62, so resolveGuardMode('antigravity',{viaDispatch:true}) falls through to watcher-fallback at packages/main/src/core/guard-session.ts:116. Verified by guard_session_start with provider=antigravity viaDispatch=true returning guardMode=watcher-fallback. This breaks the product semantics for first-class Antigravity host/runtime safety; add antigravity/agy to guard normalization or change the advertised capability/help before REVIEW can pass.
